findings.note: Fork seam (known: no test for fork keeping Branch): a child forked on another checkout keeps the parent's Branch but records its own head; over-blocks rather than clears, so fail-closed holds.

Configured-remote exclusion assumes the default fetch refspec (refs/remotes/<name>/*). A remote whose fetch refspec maps elsewhere has its default branch left in the range, widening scope (over-block only, never clears a gate). Edge configuration; no action needed beyond noting it with mr-as8.
